agent.v1.AgentRole.name: AgentRole
agent.v1.AgentRole.description: AgentRole is what an agent was launched to do.

values.name: AGENT_ROLE_IMPLEMENTER
values.description: An agent that lands work on a branch of its own.

values.name: AGENT_ROLE_REVIEWER
values.description: A child that reads another agent's work and gives a review.

values.name: AGENT_ROLE_ORCHESTRATOR
values.description: The agent drawn on a workflow's own row that hands work out.

agent.v1.AgentState.name: AgentState
agent.v1.AgentState.description: AgentState is what the panel last decided an agent was doing, read off the tail of its pane.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_IDLE
values.description: The pane is at rest with nothing typed.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_THINKING
values.description: The CLI is working on a turn.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_WAITING
values.description: The CLI is blocked on a human answering a selection.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_SETTING_UP
values.description: The agent is being launched and has no pane to read yet.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_FAILED_TO_CREATE
values.description: The launch failed, which retry_agent is for.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_FAILED_TO_CLEANUP
values.description: A delete failed to take the worktree down, and the reason is on the row.

values.name: AGENT_STATE_UNCERTAIN
values.description: The pane could be read but its tail decided nothing.

agent.v1.DocumentKind.name: DocumentKind
agent.v1.DocumentKind.description: DocumentKind is what sort of document it is.

values.name: DOCUMENT_KIND_RFC
values.description: A proposal for a change, written before building it.

values.name: DOCUMENT_KIND_REPORT
values.description: What an investigation found.

values.name: DOCUMENT_KIND_EXPLAINER
values.description: How something that already exists works.

values.name: DOCUMENT_KIND_NOTES
values.description: Anything else worth keeping.

agent.v1.MailDirection.name: MailDirection
agent.v1.MailDirection.description: MailDirection is which half of an agent's correspondence a listing asks for.

values.name: MAIL_DIRECTION_RECEIVED
values.description: The mail addressed to the agent.

values.name: MAIL_DIRECTION_SENT
values.description: The mail the agent sent.

agent.v1.MailKind.name: MailKind
agent.v1.MailKind.description: MailKind tells an agent's own mail from a notice komrad raised itself.

values.name: MAIL_KIND_PLAIN
values.description: One agent writing to another, or the person writing to an agent.

values.name: MAIL_KIND_REVIEW_ACTIVITY
values.description: Komrad saying a review has moved, naming the file the comments were written to.

values.name: MAIL_KIND_EXCHANGE_CAPPED
values.description: Komrad telling an agent that it and one other have spent their mail limit.

values.name: MAIL_KIND_DOCUMENT_EDITED
values.description: Komrad telling an agent that a person wrote or edited one of its documents in the panel.

agent.v1.ReviewAuthorKind.name: ReviewAuthorKind
agent.v1.ReviewAuthorKind.description: ReviewAuthorKind is who wrote a review message.

values.name: REVIEW_AUTHOR_KIND_HUMAN
values.description: The person running komrad.

values.name: REVIEW_AUTHOR_KIND_AGENT
values.description: The agent whose work is being read, or the reviewer reading it.

agent.v1.ReviewDeliveryState.name: ReviewDeliveryState
agent.v1.ReviewDeliveryState.description: ReviewDeliveryState is how far one of the person's comments has got towards the agent reading it. It is no stored field: it is read off the comment's own sent stamp and the newest doorbell raised against it, since the stamp outlives mail the agent deletes or lets expire. Whether the comment has been answered is a different question, read off the messages of the thread.

values.name: REVIEW_DELIVERY_STATE_UNSENT
values.description: Written down and not yet let go of.

values.name: REVIEW_DELIVERY_STATE_SENT
values.description: Released, with a doorbell still waiting to be claimed.

values.name: REVIEW_DELIVERY_STATE_DELIVERED
values.description: Released, and the agent has claimed the doorbell.

agent.v1.ReviewVerdict.name: ReviewVerdict
agent.v1.ReviewVerdict.description: ReviewVerdict is what an author concluded about a round, which is what tells the agent whether it is done rather than leaving it to read that out of the prose.

values.name: REVIEW_VERDICT_APPROVED
values.description: This round is good as it stands.

values.name: REVIEW_VERDICT_CHANGES_REQUESTED
values.description: The agent should keep working.

values.name: REVIEW_VERDICT_COMMENTED
values.description: Notes without a conclusion either way.

pullrequest.v1.Checks.name: Checks
pullrequest.v1.Checks.description: Checks is where the checks on a pull request's head commit stand, as the forge last reported them.

values.name: CHECKS_NONE
values.description: The forge reports no checks on the head.

values.name: CHECKS_PENDING
values.description: A run is still in flight.

values.name: CHECKS_PASSING
values.description: Every check passed.

values.name: CHECKS_FAILING
values.description: At least one check failed.

pullrequest.v1.Mergeability.name: Mergeability
pullrequest.v1.Mergeability.description: Mergeability is where the forge says a pull request stands against its base and its branch rules, as it last computed it.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_UNKNOWN
values.description: The forge has not computed it yet.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_CLEAN
values.description: The forge would merge it now.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_UNSTABLE
values.description: Its checks are not all passing.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_BLOCKED
values.description: A branch rule is unmet, such as a required review.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_BEHIND
values.description: The base has moved past the branch.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_CONFLICTING
values.description: The branch no longer merges cleanly into its base.

pullrequest.v1.PullRequestState.name: PullRequestState
pullrequest.v1.PullRequestState.description: PullRequestState is where a stored pull request stands, decided on the server from its stamps, its draft flag, the checks on its head, its mergeability and the forge's review decision, finished first.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_UNREAD
values.description: The repository's first sweep has not completed, so nothing is known.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_NONE
values.description: The repository has been swept and nothing was opened from the branch.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_OPEN
values.description: Open with no review decision that settles it.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_APPROVED
values.description: Open and the forge would merge it now: its rules on reviews and checks are met and the branch is level with its base.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CHANGES_REQUESTED
values.description: Open with a reviewer asking for changes.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_DRAFT
values.description: Still a draft, whatever its reviews say.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_MERGED
values.description: Merged.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CLOSED
values.description: Closed without merging.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_FAILING
values.description: Open with a failing check on its head, whatever its reviews say.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_APPROVED_WAITING
values.description: Approved on the forge but not yet mergeable: its checks are still running, its branch is behind, or a branch rule is unmet.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CONFLICTING
values.description: Open and no longer merging cleanly into its base, whatever its reviews say.

pullrequest.v1.ReviewDecision.name: ReviewDecision
pullrequest.v1.ReviewDecision.description: ReviewDecision is where a forge says a pull request's reviews stand.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_NONE
values.description: The forge has said nothing about the reviews.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_PENDING
values.description: A review the forge requires that nobody has given.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_APPROVED
values.description: The forge counts the pull request as approved.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_CHANGES_REQUESTED
values.description: A reviewer is asking for changes.

schedule.v1.ScheduleKind.name: ScheduleKind
schedule.v1.ScheduleKind.description: ScheduleKind is what a schedule does each time it fires.

values.name: SCHEDULE_KIND_IMPLEMENTER
values.description: Launches a new implementer into the workflow with the prompt.

values.name: SCHEDULE_KIND_ORCHESTRATOR
values.description: Mails the prompt to an orchestrator that is already running.

schedule.v1.ScheduleRunState.name: ScheduleRunState
schedule.v1.ScheduleRunState.description: ScheduleRunState is where River holds a firing's job.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_AVAILABLE
values.description: Waiting for a worker to pick it up.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_PENDING
values.description: Held back from running until something releases it.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_SCHEDULED
values.description: Queued to become available at a later time.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_RUNNING
values.description: Being worked right now.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_RETRYABLE
values.description: Failed an attempt and waiting to try again.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_COMPLETED
values.description: Launched its agent or delivered its mail.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_CANCELLED
values.description: Skipped on purpose, with the reason in its message.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_DISCARDED
values.description: Ran out of attempts, with the last error in its message.

view.v1.View.name: View
view.v1.View.description: View is how much of each record a listing returns, so that the panel, which draws every field, and a model reading the same endpoint through a context window ask for different amounts of the same rows.

values.name: VIEW_SUMMARY
values.description: Long text is cut to its opening, and the record says which fields were cut.

values.name: VIEW_FULL
values.description: Every field whole, however long.

worktree.v1.WorktreeFate.name: WorktreeFate
worktree.v1.WorktreeFate.description: WorktreeFate is which delete path a directory takes.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_UNOWNED
values.description: Nothing answers for the directory, which the remover takes.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_ARCHIVED
values.description: The directory's agent is put away, which the agent delete takes.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_LIVE
values.description: The directory's agent is running, which nothing takes.
